Ron Kemp won the Hampshire Constabulary 2 Miles Open Walk at Eastleigh off 250 yards. Four of our walkers, Harry Churcher, Bob McMullen, Ron Kemp and G.
Six of our walkers competed in this event in which competitors start off their marks. Ron Kemp, who is still not eligible to represent us in teams, walked well to finish third to E.

On June 24th in the Southern Championships at Southampton, Derrick Burfitt was second in the 1 mile and Ches Walker third, which is the first time we have ever had two men placed in this event. At the same meeting we had the first three home in the 2 miles walk in Harry Churcher, Percy Wright and our new member, R.
Ron Kemp was 19th, George Checkley 32nd and Gordon Waddingham 34th. At 5 miles Gregory had a comfortable lead of 100 yards in 38.22 but was ruled out at about 5½ miles.
Then came Ron Kemp closely followed by five others with Alan Robins starting steadily in the rear. A quick check at 5 miles showed leading teams to be 1, Sheffield 32; 2, Highgate 47; 3, Met.

Congratulations to every one of them, especially to Bobby Burns and Ron Kemp, who had travelled up from Eastleigh for this event. Percy Wright, who keeps a benevolent eye on these lads down there for the Club, must have been very pleased himself with the result.
Owing to a heavy cold and night work respectively, Ron Kemp and Bobbie Burns were non-starters, and we started a bare four but managed to finish in 3rd team position.
